items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Benny Carter) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Ruby Braff is made by the interviewer describing a tour in 1975. There is no evidence in the text that Benny Carter personally knew, met, or collaborated with Ruby Braff.

ctx.x: a white American as a jazz player. But I think they probably feel more strongly against thinking of him as an originator, because I know there are many white musicians who go to Europe and do very well and they are highly respected and highly thought of.

I know that when I played Nice the year before last, in 19 -- when was it, last year? 1975, it was. People like Ruby Braff and George Barnes and, oh, gee, Zoot Sims, I believe, they just loved them, you know? I'm trying to think who else was with us. A lot of breth, of our lighter-hued, you know.
I know I just did a tour this year, too, which we had Ralph Sutton, the pianist, Art Hodes, and ..
